notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST LIVE STREAM: Live Demo Gameplay Stream
notes.notes:
Hello! Hello!

Come join us as we showcase the demo of TILT live on stream. We will be playing the game, showing it live, chatting with users and also showing you a glimpse of what TILT is about.

[b]About TILT:[/b]
In Tilt, forget everything you know about gravity, as you use your A.E.R.O.G.R.I.P. to walk on walls, put cubes on the ceiling, and manipulate your gravity at will.

Welcome to the Ascendium Technologies' Aerostation! After being assigned to fix the turbine in the evaluation wing, you will have to solve the increasingly mind-bending puzzles that are thrown at you. But don't worry, you will be guided by the Julian Nigel, the head engineer at Ascendium Tech, who will try his best to direct you throughout the Aerostation. Look out for the TerraGuard, a virus aboard the facility that isn't too happy with the Aerostation's existence. Make your way through the complex quickly, who knows what might happen if that turbine fails!

[previewyoutube=D9pADWsd_lY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have played the demo and also got stuck on certain parts, then this will be perfect to follow as a tutorial. Meet us there on [b]13 JUNE 2024 4:30 PM CEST[/b]

Don't forget to download the demo and try it out yourself!
